hyperedges.description: Request lifecycle: middleware resolves tenant into ContextVar, dependencies read it for token validation, router uses it for tenant-scoped operations
Staff invite flow: admin_service creates user + stores invite token via auth_invite, auth_service verifies/accepts invite token to activate user
When a tenant schema is provisioned, seed_default_roles populates Role, Permission, and RolePermission tables with default RBAC data

hyperedges.label: Multi-tenant data isolation: schema-per-tenant + ContextVar propagation + search_path switching + per-tenant buckets + per-tenant search indexes
Resource lifecycle: generic engine defines resources -> availability/pricing strategies -> bookings consume -> reviews evaluate -> search indexes
Invite auth pipeline: admin invites -> email provider sends -> Redis stores token -> user accepts -> JWT issued -> RBAC roles assigned
